name: accounting-diya-gl-profit
title: Record sales and purchases, see your profit
description: A sole trader starts a new Basic Sole Trader book in diya-gl, enters three sales and two purchases over April and May, and reads the profit from the year table and the P&L.

steps.note: diya-gl shows a donation card once per browser, the first time the year view holds figures, and a cookie banner until the visitor answers it. Opening an example book off camera uses up the card, and declining the banner answers it, so neither covers the recording. The example is opened by deep link, which the page never autosaves, so the next page load starts empty.

steps.caption: This is diya-gl's Basic Sole Trader book. It's free and runs in your browser.
steps.headline: A sole trader's records
steps.instruction: Open the Basic Sole Trader book in diya-gl.

steps.caption: Start a new book for your business.
steps.headline: Start a new book
steps.instruction: Choose Start a new book.

steps.caption: Type your business name.
steps.headline: Your business name
steps.instruction: Enter your business name.

steps.caption: Then the year end. 31 March 2027 covers the 2026 to 2027 tax year.
steps.headline: Set the year end
steps.instruction: Enter the year end of the book.

steps.caption: Create it. The book starts empty, with a row for every month.
steps.headline: Create the book
steps.instruction: Choose Create book.

steps.label: the new book to open
steps.caption: April is open. Sales go on the left, purchases on the right.
steps.headline: Sales left, purchases right
steps.instruction: Find the add row for sales on the left and the one for purchases on the right.

scenes.chapter: April: two sales and a purchase

steps.target: input[aria-label="Date for the new sales entry"]
steps.caption: A sale. First, the date the customer paid you.
steps.headline: Date of the sale
steps.instruction: Enter the date the customer paid you in the new sales entry.

target.name: Detail for the new sales entry

steps.caption: Then what the job was.
steps.headline: What the job was
steps.instruction: Enter what the job was in Detail.

target.name: Amount for the new sales entry

steps.caption: And how much they paid: £500.
steps.headline: Amount: £500
steps.instruction: Enter the amount the customer paid.

steps.caption: Add it. The book works out every total again.
steps.headline: Add the sale
steps.instruction: Choose Add to save the sale.

steps.target: input[aria-label="Date for the new sales entry"]
steps.caption: A second job in April: a garden tidy for £300.
steps.headline: A second sale
steps.instruction: Enter the date, detail and amount of a second sale, then choose Add.

target.name: Detail for the new sales entry
Amount for the new sales entry

steps.target: input[aria-label="Date for the new purchases entry"]
steps.caption: Now a purchase: plants and compost for a job.
steps.headline: A purchase
steps.instruction: Enter the date of a purchase in the new purchases entry.

target.name: Account for the new purchases entry

steps.caption: Materials for your jobs go under cost of sales.
steps.headline: Cost of sales
steps.instruction: Choose the Account for the purchase, such as Materials under cost of sales.

target.name: Detail for the new purchases entry
Amount for the new purchases entry

steps.caption: They cost £200.
steps.headline: Amount: £200
steps.instruction: Enter the amount you paid.

steps.caption: Add it.
steps.headline: Add the plants purchase
steps.instruction: Choose Add to save the purchase.

steps.caption: April so far: £800 of sales, £200 of costs, £600 profit.
steps.headline: April's profit: £600
steps.instruction: Read April's row for its sales, costs and profit.

scenes.chapter: May: a sale and a purchase

steps.caption: Open May by clicking its row.
steps.headline: Open May
steps.instruction: Choose May's row in the year table to open the month.

steps.caption: Then show its entries.
steps.headline: Show the entries
steps.instruction: Choose Show entries to list the month's entries.

steps.target: input[aria-label="Date for the new sales entry"]
steps.caption: A bigger job in May: a new border for £700.
steps.headline: A sale in May
steps.instruction: Enter the date, detail and amount of a sale in May, then choose Add.

target.name: Detail for the new sales entry
Amount for the new sales entry

steps.target: input[aria-label="Date for the new purchases entry"]
steps.caption: And leaflets to find new customers.
steps.headline: A purchase in May
steps.instruction: Enter the date of a purchase in May.

target.name: Account for the new purchases entry

steps.caption: Leaflets go under advertising.
steps.headline: Advertising
steps.instruction: Choose Advertising as the Account.

target.name: Detail for the new purchases entry
Amount for the new purchases entry

steps.caption: They cost £100.
steps.headline: Amount: £100
steps.instruction: Enter the amount you paid.

steps.caption: Add it.
steps.headline: Add the leaflets purchase
steps.instruction: Choose Add to save the purchase.

steps.target: tr:has(> th:text-is("Year total")) td[data-r-key^="cell/Profit & Loss Acc!C24 "]
steps.caption: The year so far: £1,500 of sales, £300 of costs, £1,200 profit.
steps.headline: Profit so far: £1,200

steps.caption: The P&L tab sets the same figures out as a profit and loss account.
steps.headline: Open the P&L

steps.label: the profit and loss account to show

steps.caption: Net profit: £1,200. That's your sales less what you spent to earn them.
steps.headline: Net profit: £1,200
steps.instruction: Choose the P&L tab, then read Net profit on the profit and loss account.
